svg.aria-label: A scrapbook retro of a call. The book opens on The meeting, what happened: four polaroids say it opened by apologising for the slides, the big question came long before the answer, one finding stuck when they said it back in their own words, and it ended on let's plan, not no. The page turns to How the deck was made, the run-up, from the AI's session log: most changes landed on the day of the call, the same instructions had to be given twice, some visuals quietly went missing overnight, and the version actually presented came together last. Then Next time, two ticked sticky notes. You: lead with the answer, skip the apology, cut slides you'd introduce with a doubt, end by asking them to choose. Your AI: treat the deadline as a freeze, check every instruction is done, never drop content quietly, build the presenting version first. Keep these? Yes is ticked, a gold star goes on, and the book closes, saved for next time. Based on a real call, details changed.
